prompt: Synthesize the completed discovery, security and operations research tasks into an architecture comparison.
expected_output: Retrieves durable claims/sources and dependency outputs, groups evidence by decision criterion, distinguishes established/reported/unresolved evidence, links conclusions to claims/sources, and clearly preserves limitations and unknowns.

assertions.text: Retrieves durable claims and sources from research memory (doesn't fabricate from conversation)
assertions.rationale: Synthesis must work from persisted evidence, not conversational knowledge

assertions.text: Retrieves dependency task outputs (discovery, security, operations)
assertions.rationale: Synthesis depends on completed research tasks

assertions.text: Groups evidence by decision criterion (e.g., security, performance, operations)
Distinguishes between established evidence (Verified), reported assertions, and unresolved propositions
assertions.rationale: Preserves evidence quality levels without flattening them

assertions.text: Links conclusions back to specific claim IDs and source evidence
assertions.rationale: Enables traceability and verification of synthesis claims

assertions.text: Preserves limitations and unknowns explicitly (doesn't hide gaps)
assertions.rationale: Honest synthesis acknowledges what is not known
